thesis: The episode introduces Jake Taylor, the CEO of Farnham Street Investments and author of the book The Rebel Allocator, which is written as a novel to make the topic of capital allocation accessible to beginners. Taylor discusses receiving a copy of his book from Charlie Munger, who found the book so compelling that he suggested it could be made into a movie, prompting Taylor to team up with a screenplay writer to develop the project. Taylor also shares that his favorite feedback comes from small business owners who apply the book's frameworks to improve their own businesses and from readers who feel confident enough to share the book with their wives and children.
